definitions.full: H7589. sheat שְׁאָט noun [masculine] despite, contempt (expanded from שׁוּט above, Kö i. 439 ; ii. 1. 486); — absolute בְּנֶפֶשׁ ׳בִּשׁ Ezek 25:15 with despite in the soul ; construct נֶפֶשׁ ׳בִּשׁ 36:5 ; suffix בְּנ ׳בְּכָלשָֽֿׁאטְךָ 25:6 (Ges § 23c Kö ii. 1. 67 ). שׁוּל (√ of following; compare Arabic hang down loose ).
